source.license: CC0-1.0 (site-wide: all ambientCG assets are published under Creative Commons CC0 1.0; the v2 API response carries no per-asset license field)
source.extraction: One full-zip download (10,710,313 B), three members inflated; no local GPU, imagegen or Blender was used
source.authenticityDisclosure: ambientCG creationMethod = PBRProcedural: maps are ambientCG-authored, not a photo scan. Photo-scanned alternatives were evaluated and rejected on surface character: PolyHaven leafy_grass (lush meadow with plant litter), grass_ground and sparse_grass (dry/soil-dominant - the failure class of the earlier 'Sparse Grass' attempt that read as bare soil). The visual gate owns final acceptance.

asset.physicalSizeSource: ambientCG v2 API dimensionX/dimensionY = 140x140 cm (q=Grass001 response, 2026-09-20)

budgets.note: Delivery pass fetched the zip once (10.71 MB). An earlier delivery attempt re-downloaded the same zip before aborting on a local path error; both passes are counted in totalWireBytes. No other network traffic for this lane.

uvContract.rootConvention: build/ground.ts bakes world tiling into geometry UVs: UV_LAWN=96.0 m per UV unit; shared textures keep texture.repeat as the ONLY per-texture multiplier.
uvContract.repeatFormula: texture.repeat = uvMetresPerUnit / tilePhysicalMetres, applied once per map by applyGroundPbrCanaryMaps
uvContract.neverDoubleRepeat: the canary never rescales geometry UVs; ground.ts scaleUV and UV_LAWN keep their existing values

calibration.rationale: Photo mean (68.2, 91.7, 40.6) is already darker than the muted baseline target (~87, 121, 59); material.color can only multiply darker, so identity preserves the baseline color state. Darkness vs baseline is a paired-view decision for the root gate: levers are a brighter asset (Grass004) or a gain in the wetness colorNode hook, never an exposure/light change.
